title: s-palindrome
statementMd:
Let's call a string "`s-palindrome`" if it is symmetric about the middle of the string. For example, the string "`oHo`" is "`s-palindrome`", but the string "`aa`" is not. The string "`aa`" is not "`s-palindrome`", because the second half of it is not a mirror reflection of the first half.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/baf8111c4cf709f89a55071c2064096a68c3c232.png) English alphabet

You are given a string $*s*$. Check if the string is "`s-palindrome`".

## Input

The only line contains the string $*s*$ ($1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 1000$) which consists of only English letters.

## Output

Print "`TAK`" if the string $*s*$ is "`s-palindrome`" and "`NIE`" otherwise.
statementZhMd:
如果一个字符串关于字符串的中点对称，我们就称其为“`s-palindrome`”。例如，字符串“`oHo`”是“`s-palindrome`”，但字符串“`aa`”不是。字符串“`aa`”不是“`s-palindrome`”，因为它的后半部分不是前半部分的镜像反射。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/baf8111c4cf709f89a55071c2064096a68c3c232.png) 英文字母

给定一个字符串 $*s*$。请判断该字符串是否为“`s-palindrome`”。

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含字符串 $*s*$（$1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 1000$），该字符串仅由英文字母组成。

## 输出格式

如果字符串 $*s*$ 是“`s-palindrome`”，输出“`TAK`”；否则输出“`NIE`”。
